headline: S&P -0.5% at Lunch; Real Estate Leads

writeup.headline: S&P -0.5% at Lunch; Real Estate Leads
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Alphabet, Microsoft Capex Miss Deepens AI Spending Fears. The AI names are down and the average stock is up: money is rotating out of the AI giants into the rest of the market. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has climbed back since the opening bell.
